drums.tags: Cinematic ambient electronic. A repetitive, high-pitched digital synth bell pattern plays a four-note ostinato in 4/4 time. A deep, sub-heavy synth bass enters with long, sustained notes. A low-pass filtered kick drum provides a steady pulse at 120 BPM. Atmospheric pads with long release times create a dense harmonic wash. A distorted, industrial-style synth lead enters in the second half, playing a slow, descending melody with heavy reverb and delay. The track is in the key of C minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[high-pitched digital synth bell ostinato]
[sub-bass enters with sustained root notes]

[Section A]
[low-pass filtered kick drum pulse]
[atmospheric synth pads with long release]

[Section B]
[distorted industrial synth lead enters]
[heavy reverb and delay on lead melody]
[kick drum becomes more prominent]

[Outro]
[lead synth fades out]
[synth bell ostinato continues alone]
[final sub-bass swell]

bass.tags: Industrial techno. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a heavy, saturated low-end pulse at 135 BPM in the key of F minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and high-pass filtering plays a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. A white noise snare with a gated reverb hits on beats 2 and 4. A high-pitched, resonant acid synth line enters with automated filter cutoff and resonance sweeps. Industrial foley textures and metallic clangs are processed with rhythmic delay and bit-crushing. The arrangement features a breakdown with a low-pass filter sweep on the master bus before a sudden drop back into the full percussive groove.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum pulse, metallic percussive synth sequence]

[Section A]
[white noise snare enters on 2 and 4, hi-hat sixteenth notes]
[resonant acid synth line with filter sweeps]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out, low-pass filter sweep on synths, metallic foley textures]

[Section B]
[kick drum returns, bit-crushed industrial clangs, high-resonance synth lead]
